$comment: The context ladder: every level every eval task is run at. Each level gives the agent ONE source of Helix knowledge and nothing else (no AGENTS.md under the MCP or the lint loop), so each one's effect is measured on its own; full repo is everything together. Single source for `pnpm eval:ladder` (what to generate), Proof (proof.config.mjs) and Storybook's Data/Eval Gallery (rows). `flags` are eval:generate flags; `explain` is the plain-language tooltip the galleries show next to the level.

levels.label: bare
levels.explain: Nothing about Helix: no guide, no files, no tools. Shows what the model already knows on its own — usually it invents package and prop names.

levels.label: llms.txt
levels.explain: Only llms.txt, the short summary of Helix published for AI tools. Tests whether a summary alone is enough to build with Helix.

levels.label: agents-md
levels.explain: Only AGENTS.md, Helix's full guide for coding agents (components, props, tokens, rules) — no repo, no tools.

levels.label: mcp
levels.detail: Only the Helix MCP tools — no guide, no repo
levels.explain: No guide — only the Helix MCP tools: while it works, the agent can look up component contracts, search tokens and check its own code.

levels.label: lint loop
levels.detail: Only its Helix lint problems, sent back to fix — no guide, no repo
levels.explain: No guide — the agent answers, Helix's lint rules check the code, and the problems go back to it to fix (up to 2 rounds).

levels.label: full repo
levels.detail: Everything together: AGENTS.md and the whole Helix repo
levels.explain: The agent works inside the whole Helix repository: AGENTS.md, contracts, docs and source — the most context it can get.
